Name: Enhanced Player Sprites
Author: Jackeloko
Description:
[font=Arial][size=4][b][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/6ylWhAz.gif[/img]﻿﻿
[size=5]Enhanced Player Sprites[size=2][/size][/size][/center][/b][/size][/font][center][b]﻿[font=Arial][size=4][size=5][size=2]by Jackeloko
[/size][/size][/size][/font][/b]

[/center][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/ynNRTto.png[/img]﻿
[font=Arial][size=2]
This is my project to revamp the appearance of the player character. I call it EPS for short.
It gives your farmer a much needed makeover, and there are dozens of customization options that can be combined to suit your tastes!
This is an ongoing project, and more features will be released over time.
Of course, if you have any suggestions on how to improve this mod, feel free to let me know as well!

[i]NOTE: This mod makes very drastic changes to the player sprites and is therefore likely not compatible with most mods that add customization of the player character as they were likely done with the vanilla spritework in mind. There are options avaliable to disable some conflicting features of this mod, though.[/i][u][i]


[/i][/u][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/xZSCLnF.png[/img]
[/b]
1. Install [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
2. Install [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
3. Extract the EPS folder into the Mods folder
4. Run the game with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
5. Done!
[/size][/font][font=Arial][size=2]

[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/e1iCG9Y.png[/img]
[/b][b]
Alternative 1 (Recommended):[/b]
1. Install [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
2. Open the game and press the settings button at the bottom-left of the title screen
3. Change the settings to your heart's desire
4. Save your changes, and done!

[b]Alternative 2 (Not Recommended):[/b]
1. Open the config.json file with any text editing software
2. Change the settings to your heart's desire
3. Save your changes, and done!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/VVw7OLN.png[/img]﻿
[/size][/font][font=Arial][size=2]
[b]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.X[/b]

[b]Mostly Multiplayer Compatible[/b]
- Only players with the mod installed will be able to see the new sprites
- Players of the same gender will share the same configs (face, sleeves, gloves, shoes, etc.)
- Some configs affect all players, irregardless of their gender

[b]Semi-compatible with hairstyle/clothing mods[/b]
- EPS hairstyles/clothing can be disabled to allow for custom hairstyles/clothing
- Hairstyles/clothing outside of this mod may not fit the EPS body correctly

[b]NOT compatible with "total conversion" player mods[/b]
- This includes but is not limited to:
Feminine Female Farmer, Anthro Farmer Continued, More Elegant Female Farmer body


[img]https://i.imgur.com/xzup6jY.png[/img]

- Add more customization options.
- Improve the look of the shirts.
- Fix bugs.[/size][/font][size=2]
[/size][/center]
